# proxmox_guest_firewall_options (Data Source)

Reads the firewall options of one QEMU/LXC guest from `/nodes/{node}/{guest}/{vmid}/firewall/options`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_guest_firewall_options" "vm100" {
  node       = "pve-1"
  guest_type = "qemu"
  vm_id      = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `guest_type` (String) `qemu` or `lxc`.
- `node` (String) Cluster node.
- `vm_id` (Number) Guest VMID.

### Read-Only

- `dhcp` (Boolean)
- `enable` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ipfilter` (Boolean)
- `log_level_in` (String)
- `log_level_out` (String)
- `macfilter` (Boolean)
- `ndp` (Boolean)
- `policy_in` (String)
- `policy_out` (String)
- `radv` (Boolean)
